summary: Backend+frontend translation/push readiness regression run completed on public preview. Backend local translation mostly passes (12/13) with one real output regression. Frontend chat panel translation core flow passed, but long-press translation menu and inline error path could not be cleanly validated in automation due gesture/reload instability.

critical.issue: Emoji preservation regression: input 'Order #12345 is ready ✅🙂' to Spanish returns 'Orden #12345 está listo' (emoji removed). Requirement says emoji/numbers should remain valid.

minor.issue: One flaky infra 502 (Cloudflare bad gateway) observed once during long-input test; immediate retry passed.

ui_bugs.issue: Could not open long-press action sheet reliably in web automation; msg-list-translate did not appear after multiple hold attempts.

integration_issues.issue: Controlled request abort was tested as a MOCKED browser interception; expected inline chat-translation-error did not surface before Metro/web runtime disconnect noise. Retry path later returned translated output.

action_items: Fix local translation post-processing to retain emoji symbols while preserving numbers/punctuation.
Investigate long-press gesture path for chat bubbles on web preview so msg-list-translate reliably opens in automated/mobile-web interactions.
Stabilize/verify inline translation error UX (chat-translation-error) under real network failures; current controlled abort test had runtime disconnect noise.

Push build-readiness mismatch to requested target: app.json currently uses android package + iOS bundle com.emergent.communityspeak.z97eev, not the requested com.emergent.lingua / unchanged iOS ID from checklist.
critical_code_review_comments: frontend/app/learn/goal.tsx now correctly redirects legacy /learn/goal to /learn/set-goal.
Push guardrail behavior is correct in backend/routes/push.py: /api/register-push returns 503 when EMERGENT_PUSH_KEY is placeholder and overrides spoofed user_id with authenticated user.
backend translation modules reviewed: no httpx import in local_text_translation.py / translation_service.py / routes/ai.py (no external translation client in this path).
app.json identifiers do not align with the requested native push package/bundle constraints in this review request.

success_rate.frontend: Partial run (core chat panel translation passed; long-press and controlled-error paths not fully validated)

seed_data_creation: Sent one Bengali QA message in existing chat 98ea1271-de38-4a76-8be9-c24210657858 during UI verification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Confirmed: public app load, auth login, chat panel translation (tr-more-languages search/select bn+ar, tr-input/tr-run/tr-result-text Tap to use), translation target switch clears prior result, /learn/goal code-level redirect exists, audio assets 200 at /assets/media/sounds/ringtone.wav and outgoing-call.mp3, TSC noEmit passed. Not fully validated in this run: reliable long-press action menu path and real inline error rendering due web runtime instability during controlled abort.
rca_of_issue: Emoji loss RCA: local translation output strips emoji tokens for at least en->es path while keeping numeric token (#12345). Repro: QA login -> POST /api/ai/translate body {text:'Order #12345 is ready ✅🙂', target_language:'es'} -> 200 with translated text missing emoji. Mitigation candidate: preserve/safeguard non-linguistic glyphs (emoji) before model pass and restore after translation or configure tokenizer handling.
